Subject: Prep: Steering Committee sync & Decision Criteria for Finova POC

Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the steering committee aligned before the pilot kickoff:

Summary of agreement from discovery:
- Reducing inference cost by ~40% (estimated) on your nightly batch workloads is a key success metric.
- Latency SLO for interactive internal tools: 200ms p95.
- Data controls: VPC + customer-managed KMS required for PII workflows.

Proposed ask for the steering committee session (45 minutes):
1) Roll call: confirm executive sponsor and decision owner.
2) Success criteria: cost threshold, latency target, and minimum feature set.
3) Procurement & legal checklist: procurement timeline, contract redlines, and SOC2 evidence.
4) Pilot timeline and go/no-go gates.

Please confirm: who will be the exec sponsor and who from procurement/legal needs to be in the room. I suggest scheduling next Thursday or Friday (Mar 26–27) 45 minutes.

I attached a short exec briefing and a one-page decision criteria template to make the discussion efficient. Also linking our mutual-action-plan doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-Finova-MAP

If you prefer, I can draft a short agenda and attendee list once you confirm names.

Thanks,
Karthik

--

Quick internal note (cc'ing customer so they're aware of the ask):
- For procurement: we should be prepared to offer an initial 30-day pilot contract with a clause to add a SOC2 attestation timeline (45–60 days) OR a private deployment option with an enterprise SLA. Procurement usually pushes for one of these.
- For pricing: I'll prepare a backend compute estimate and a per-token operational estimate. Karthik/Marissa, please let me know if you want the estimate modeled as monthly cost or as total pilot run cost.
- Risk items to raise in the meeting: network egress assumptions, KMS integration lead time, and any data residency constraints.

I'll annotate the RFP and send that back by EOD Wednesday.

-Monica
